newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guizhou Liyuan to offer 15 mln A shares.
newsitem.headline: Guizhou Liyuan to offer 15 mln A shares.

text.p: Guizhou Liyuan Hydraulic Pressure Co Ltd will launch an offer of 15 million A shares via the Shanghai bourse's automated quotation system soon and list the equity in Shanghai, a company spokesman said on Monday.
Approved by the China Securities Regulatory Commission, the offer has been tentatively priced at 5.80 yuan per share, the spokesman told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
Precise price and timing of the issue would be made public in the firm's offer prospectus in the near future, the official said.
He said Haitong Securities has been appointed as the main underwriter for the issue.
Liyuan, which is engaged in the production of hydraulic pumps and automobile parts, currently has total share capital of 36.10 million state shares, he said.
Liyuan, based in Guiyang, the capital of the southwestern Guizhou province, plans to use proceeds from the offer to upgrade its production technology, the official said.
He said Liyuan forecast after-tax profits of about 14 million yuan for this year. He declined to provide profit figures for earlier years.
